description: This file defines the Java class ResourceDeleted, which represents an event emitted after a resource is deleted within a policy framework. It includes constructors, JSON serialization/deserialization logic, and methods for accessing properties related to the resource deletion event.

classes.name: ResourceDeleted
classes.description: Immutable event class representing the deletion of a resource within a policy, including JSON serialization/deserialization and property access methods.

methods.name: ResourceDeleted
methods.description: Private constructor initializing a ResourceDeleted instance with policy ID, label, resource key, revision, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating ResourceDeleted instances, with variations for deprecations, including from JSON string or object.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static methods to create an instance from JSON string or JSON object, deserializing the event.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry associated with the deleted resource.

methods.name: getResourceKey
methods.description: Returns the ResourceKey of the deleted resource.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns a JSONPointer to the resource resource path represented by the event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new ResourceDeleted instance with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ResourceDeleted instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
